description: Check if an action is allowed by cloud governance policies. Supports regional PII profiles (v1.1) for country-specific detection. Returns permission status and matched policy. Requires TORK_API_KEY.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent requesting the action

industry.description: Industry profile to activate for specialized PII patterns

parameters.description: Parameters being passed to the tool (optional)

region.description: Regional PII profiles to activate (e.g. ['ae', 'in']). Available: au, us, gb, eu, ae, sa, ng, in, jp, cn, kr, br

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being called

name: tork_governance_check
